name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code — parallel AI coding with Git worktrees and native cmux.app. A King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own cmux.app workspace with role-coloured sidebar badges, native notifications, live state lines via dynamic descriptions, and manual attention-badge overrides (mark-unread). Three-tier hierarchy: Workspace per master, Tab for visible sub-agent spawns, Split for predefined dual-view. Model-tiered sub-agent spawn defaults (haiku/sonnet → background Agent(); opus → tab) keep fan-outs fast without losing visibility on expensive work. King reads ALL context at session start (workspace + project CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, personal notes); uses watchman outputs at every decision point; auto-fires the pre-commit gate on every un-gated sentinel. Workers are interchangeable capacity; King assigns task scope per-dispatch. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts. Bootstrap with /kingdom:init; spawn with /kingdom:start (auto-execute, silent branch reuse); audit gaps with /kingdom:update; gracefully close with /kingdom:exit. Per-task multi-layer task files + 4/5-step closer artifact pipeline make the work auditable. Won't touch your project files, develop/main branches, shell config, or git config.
